title: BPW-2026-0543
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0543
BCA + BOE
CD 11
CONTRACT ACCEPTANCE – HYPERION TREATMENT PLANT HEADWORKS IMPROVEMENTS (CIP 2409) AND HEADWORKS ODOR CONTROL UPGRADE (CIP 2344)
Recommending the Board:
ACCEPT this contract;
DO NOT ASSESS Murray Plumbing and Heating Corp. dba Murray Co. with a penalty in the amount of $126,144 for the unauthorized subcontractor substitution of one bid-listed MBE/SBE/EBE subcontractor; and
INSTRUCT the Director, Office of Accounting, to disencumber the potential penalty amount of $126,144 from the project fund and release that amount to the Contractor.
(W.O.: SZH11746, SZH11748)
summary: Acceptance of the completed Hyperion Treatment Plant headworks improvement and odor control contract with Murray Plumbing and Heating, and a decision not to penalize the contractor $126,144 for swapping out a bid-listed subcontractor without authorization.

details.bureau: Bureau of Contract Administration; Bureau of Engineering
